title: The prose independence-of-premise rule negates an implication instead of its antecedent.
details: Printed p. 21 (PDF p. 21), immediately after Corollary 23, the rule conclusion begins ¬(χ→φ)∨(¬χ→ψ). It should be (¬χ→φ)∨(¬χ→ψ), as correctly displayed in Example 25(1) on the same page and established by Corollary 23(2). The malformed rule is false: χ=⊥,φ=⊤,ψ=⊥ makes its premise ¬χ→(φ∨ψ) a theorem but its printed conclusion classically false. This is a local parenthesis/negation slip; the intended admissibility result and its root-gluing proof survive unchanged. The corpus uses the Example 25(1) form, without importing HA or the later classification of admissible rules. Current corpus adoption: intuitionistic-propositional-disjunction-property#harrop-admissibility, intuitionistic-propositional-disjunction-property#harrop-not-derivable.
